notation.offset: Beat offset from the beginning of the song.
notation.length: One duration is the tone/effect length. Two comma-separated durations are effect length and post-effect sustain length.
notation.trillRule: The two notes surrounding ~ must be exactly one semitone apart.
notation.sustainRule: A second length value requires ... and sustains the final/resulting pitch.

instrumentAttributes.type: Instrument engine type. oscillator is currently supported.
instrumentAttributes.waveform: Default OscillatorNode waveform. Defaults to sine.

envelope.attack: Amplitude attack time in seconds. Defaults to 0.
envelope.decay: Amplitude decay time in seconds. Defaults to 0.
envelope.sustain: Amplitude sustain level from 0 through 1. Defaults to 1.
envelope.release: Amplitude release time in seconds. Defaults to 0 and extends the audible event when positive.

instrumentAttributes.partials: Optional harmonic oscillator array. Each partial supports ratio, gain, detune in cents, and an optional waveform override. Defaults to one fundamental partial at ratio 1 and gain 1.

filter.type: BiquadFilterNode type, for example lowpass, highpass, or bandpass.
filter.frequency: Base filter cutoff/center frequency in Hz. Defaults to 5000 when a filter is present.
filter.Q: Filter resonance/Q. Defaults to the Web Audio node value when omitted.
filter.envelopeAmount: Initial filter-frequency offset in Hz. It settles to frequency over the amplitude envelope attack plus decay.

noise.amount: White-noise transient gain. Zero or omission disables noise.
noise.decay: Noise transient decay time in seconds. Defaults to 0.03 when noise is enabled.

instrumentAttributes.detune: Base oscillator detune in cents. Defaults to 0.

pitchEnvelope.attack: Seconds from base detune to the pitch-envelope peak. Defaults to 0.
pitchEnvelope.decay: Seconds from the pitch-envelope peak back to base detune. Defaults to 0.

instrumentAttributes.velocitySensitivity: How strongly event dynamics affect gain, from 0 through 1. Defaults to 1.
instrumentAttributes.trillStep: Beat subdivision used by trill effects. Defaults to 1/8.

reverb.wet: Reverb send level from 0 through 1. Zero or omission disables reverb.
reverb.decay: Generated reverb impulse decay time in seconds. Defaults to 1.5.

delay.time: Delay time in seconds. Zero or omission disables delay.
delay.feedback: Delay feedback from 0 through 0.95. Defaults to 0.
delay.wet: Delay send level from 0 through 1. Zero or omission disables delay.

tremolo.rate: Tremolo LFO rate in Hz. Zero or omission disables tremolo.

distortion.amount: Soft-clipping distortion amount from 0 through 1. Zero or omission disables distortion.

instrumentAttributes.phoneFallback: Optional instrument name used on phone-sized/mobile devices. The original instrument remains primary; legacy-square remains the final runtime fallback.
instrumentAttributes.displayName: Optional user-facing name for instrument selectors.
